google.enableHint: Allow store users to sign in with their Google account.
google.clientIdHint: Found in Google Cloud Console under APIs & Services → Credentials.
google.redirectHint: Add this URL to the Authorised redirect URIs list in Google Cloud Console.

oauth.enableHint: Allow store users to sign in with their {{provider}} account.
oauth.clientIdHint: From the {{provider}} developer console for your registered OAuth app.
oauth.redirectHint: Add this exact URL to the list of authorised redirect URIs in the {{provider}} developer console.

apple.enableHint: Allow store users to sign in with their Apple ID.
apple.serviceIdHint: Reverse-DNS identifier of the "Services ID" you created in Apple Developer (e.g. <0>com.tortacrm.signin</0>). This is the OAuth client_id.
apple.keyIdHint: 10-character ID of the Sign-In key you created under <0>Apple Developer → Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Keys</0> (with Sign-In with Apple enabled).
apple.privateKeyHint: Paste the full PEM contents of the <0>AuthKey_*.p8</0> file you downloaded from Apple (you can only download it ONCE) or upload the file directly. We use this to sign Apple's ES256 client_secret JWT on every token exchange.
apple.redirectHint: Add this exact URL to your Service ID configuration under <0>Sign In with Apple → Configure → Return URLs</0>. Apple requires HTTPS for this URL — local <1>http://</1> won't be accepted by Apple even for testing.
apple.httpsWarn: Apple rejects <0>http://</0> Return URLs. For local testing, expose your dev server via ngrok / Cloudflare Tunnel and update the project's Site URL to that HTTPS address.
apple.errNotP8: That file doesn't look like a .p8 (missing -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- header)
apple.errTeamId: Team ID must be exactly 10 characters
apple.errKeyId: Key ID must be exactly 10 characters
apple.errPrivateKey: Private Key must be the PEM contents of the .p8 file

settings.title: Settings
settings.generalSub: Timezone and currency drive how dates and money render across the dashboard.
settings.tzAutoHint: Auto-detect mode — CRM syncs with your browser ({{tz}}) every 30 min and on every page load. Pick a zone below to lock it manually.
settings.tzManualHint: Manual mode — locked to <0>{{tz}}</0>. Your browser reports <1>{{browserTz}}</1>.
settings.currencyHint: Every price on the dashboard — products, orders, analytics, invoices — uses this currency's symbol and decimal style. <0>Past orders snapshot their currency at the time of purchase</0>, so historical reports stay accurate after you change this.
settings.inventorySub: How stock partitions consume from batches, and how SKU prices are entered.
settings.fifoHint: FIFO (first-in, first-out) — oldest batches sell first. Best for food, cosmetics, anything with an expiry date.
settings.lifoHint: LIFO (last-in, first-out) — newest batches sell first. Uncommon — use only if you have a specific accounting reason.
settings.hidePrice: Hide Price column — enter Cost only
settings.hidePriceHint: Product Overview hides the Price column for L2 SKUs. Merchant types <0>Cost</0>; public price is auto-set to <1>Cost × (1 + margin / 100)</1>.
settings.defaultMarginHint: Used to compute selling price when Hide Price is on. e.g. 50 → price = cost × 1.5.
settings.barcodeSub: These toggles pre-fill the "Advanced encoding" section in the Print barcodes modal.
settings.includeSerialHint: Each printed sticker gets a unique -NNNN suffix
settings.dangerZoneSub: Irreversible actions — rotate API key, delete project.
settings.comingSoonHint: Project rotation and deletion are not yet exposed in the UI. Until then, drop a request via support.

currencyModal.title: Change currency?
currencyModal.bullet1: <0>Numbers don't change.</0> A product priced at 99.99 stays 99.99 — only the symbol updates.
currencyModal.bullet2: <0>Past orders keep their original currency.</0> An invoice issued in {{symbol}} stays in {{symbol}} forever.
currencyModal.bullet3: <0>No FX rate is applied.</0> If you want to re-price products at the current exchange rate, use Products → Bulk update price after switching.
